change.title: Add three demo functions and package PyCharm plugin 0.1.2
change.intent: Provide a real guided-review demo and distribute version 0.1.2 of the PyCharm plugin with reproducible build and installation instructions.
change.scope: Three Python demo functions, renderer regression coverage, plugin version 0.1.2, versioned JAR and installable ZIP, and updated build documentation.
non_goals: No changes to plugin runtime behavior or verifier rules.

workflow.title: Normalize a greeting
workflow.description: greet trims surrounding whitespace and substitutes World for blank input before formatting the greeting. Check that a named and a blank greeting have predictable results.

workflow.title: Clamp an integer
workflow.description: clamp returns the nearest inclusive bound for an out-of-range integer and leaves in-range values unchanged. Reversed bounds raise ValueError so callers cannot silently use an invalid interval. Check boundary, equal-bound, and error cases.

workflow.title: Create an ASCII slug
workflow.description: slugify lowercases input, replaces consecutive non-ASCII-alphanumeric characters with one hyphen, and removes edge hyphens. Punctuation-only input produces an empty string; Unicode transliteration is outside this demo. Check repeated separators and empty results.

workflow.title: Verify rendering after the manifest changes
workflow.description: The repository manifest now describes the demo PR, so the rendering test must compare the heading with the loaded title. A separate synthetic manifest retains a fixed expected title to verify rendering independently. Confirm both tests pass when the repository manifest changes.

workflow.title: Build and install plugin version 0.1.2
workflow.description: The Gradle version controls the plugin metadata and versioned JAR and ZIP names. The updated documentation explains required tools and fresh-clone setup. Build check and buildPlugin, then install the ZIP in PyCharm and confirm version 0.1.2. The JAR is supplied separately as a build artifact; live installation has not been checked.

files.reason: greet trims surrounding whitespace and substitutes World for blank input before formatting the greeting. Check that a named and a blank greeting have predictable results.

clamp returns the nearest inclusive bound for an out-of-range integer and leaves in-range values unchanged. Reversed bounds raise ValueError so callers cannot silently use an invalid interval. Check boundary, equal-bound, and error cases.

slugify lowercases input, replaces consecutive non-ASCII-alphanumeric characters with one hyphen, and removes edge hyphens. Punctuation-only input produces an empty string; Unicode transliteration is outside this demo. Check repeated separators and empty results.
Describe this demo PR and point each review step to its function.
Render the demo manifest as a readable Markdown walkthrough.
Assert that rendering uses the current manifest title, replacing a hardcoded bootstrap title that caused this PR to fail CI.
review_notes: The synthetic Line target test still checks a fixed expected heading, independently of the repository manifest.

files.reason: Include fresh-clone build guidance and link to the version 0.1.2 plugin package.
Document prerequisites, build commands, installation troubleshooting, and the versioned JAR and ZIP paths.
Update the plugin artifact path to version 0.1.2.
Set the plugin version to 0.1.2 so packaged metadata and output filenames agree.
Supply the built version 0.1.2 plugin JAR requested for this update.
Supply the version 0.1.2 plugin ZIP for installation through PyCharm.

commands.evidence: All 15 tests pass after refreshing the demo manifest and replacing the obsolete title expectation.
Named and blank greetings; clamping below, inside, above and at bounds; equal and reversed bounds; slug punctuation and repeated separators all passed.
Gradle build succeeded; all 72 diff navigation checks passed. Packaged JAR metadata reports 0.1.2, and ZIP contains the identical JAR.

known_gaps: The live PyCharm UI has not been exercised for this PR.

risks.risk: These small examples could be mistaken for production utilities; slugify drops non-ASCII characters.
risks.mitigation: Keep the functions in demo/ and document their exact behavior.

assumptions: The requested PR is a demonstration for guided diff review.
limitations: Live PyCharm installation and UI behavior have not been checked.
